title: IDC: AgiBot Leads Global Humanoid Robot Shipments With Over 8,600 Units in H1
key_facts: IDC data cited by Gasgoo: global humanoid robot shipments neared 25,000 units in the first half of 2026, up 432.1% year on year.
China accounted for more than 19,000 of those units, roughly 77.9% of the global total.
AgiBot shipped over 8,600 units, about 35% of the global market and over 45% of the domestic market, ranking first by shipment volume and revenue.
More than 300 AgiBot robots have been on regular duty at the Chimelong Space Shuttle park in Hengqin since 24 Sep, for performances and educational tours.
AgiBot deployed 100 robots as shopping guides at ASDA stores; its Lingxi X2 works over 10 hours a day.
The AgiBot Jingling G2 is live on a tablet quality-inspection line at Longcheer Technology's Nanchang factory.
IDC projects global humanoid shipments will exceed 750,000 units by 2030.
quote_evidence: Global humanoid robot shipments neared 25,000 units in the first half of 2026, surging 432.1% year-on-year, per the latest IDC data.

AgiBot shipped over 8,600 units during the period, capturing about 35% of the global market and over 45% of the domestic market—ranking first in the industry by both shipment volume and revenue scale.
IDC projects that global humanoid robot shipments will exceed 750,000 units by 2030, signaling an acceleration toward large-scale application.
why_it_matters_hint: Humanoid robots are being sold in the thousands, mostly in China, and one Chinese maker holds about a third of the market.
event_date: First half of 2026 (IDC data); article published 9 Oct 2026
notes: IDC's own release was not seen; Gasgoo is the only outlet read. The deployment examples are given without attribution or independent confirmation. Release date of the IDC data not stated.
